profile_text.body:
IBM is a public company founded in 1911 and headquartered in Armonk, NY, USA, trading under the ticker IBM. Its most recent 10-K, covering the period ending 2025-12-31, reported revenue of $67,535,000,000. The harvested OpenPages product page describes IBM OpenPages as a scalable, AI-powered governance, risk, and compliance platform that runs on any cloud or on-premises and is sold in modules, so organizations deploy only the components they need.

IBM's AI products include IBM watsonx, described as an enterprise AI platform, IBM watsonx.governance for AI lifecycle governance with model evaluation, monitoring, and documentation, and IBM OpenPages with Watson, a GRC platform with AI-specific modules for risk assessment and regulatory mapping. The site says OpenPages can connect to watsonx.ai or third-party and custom models through an API-based architecture, and describes an OpenPages MCP Server that lets AI agents create, query, and update GRC objects. IBM watsonx.governance is noted as a Leader in Gartner's first AI Governance Platforms Magic Quadrant in June 2026, and the site cites recognition in the IDC MarketScape Worldwide AI-Enabled Financial Governance, Risk, and Compliance 2026 Vendor Assessment. The site also states that Citi partnered with IBM to automate its internal audit process using AI and machine learning.

Litigation exposure recorded for IBM is in New York, with 458 cases.
